criteria_matrix.title: Verify Gate A–D files unchanged
criteria_matrix.evidence: Zero production code files modified. retrieval.py and gate_a/b/c/d remain unmodified.

criteria_matrix.title: Verify Gate B/C/D interfaces correctly separated
criteria_matrix.evidence: Decoupled adapters wrap gates; 9 distinct JSON domain entity schemas defined in interface contract.

criteria_matrix.title: Verify LEGACY_ONLY remains default
criteria_matrix.evidence: operating_mode default attribute set to LEGACY_ONLY in feature flag schema.

criteria_matrix.title: Verify feature flags are independent
criteria_matrix.evidence: 7 independent boolean flags defined with prerequisite validation rules.

criteria_matrix.title: Verify invalid flag combinations fail closed
criteria_matrix.evidence: Validator rules ERR_01..ERR_07 and error taxonomy force fail-closed fallback to LEGACY_ONLY.

criteria_matrix.title: Verify rollback is migration-free
criteria_matrix.evidence: Zero DB migrations required; rollback executes in < 100ms via env var, CLI, or sentinel file.

criteria_matrix.title: Verify emergency disable exists
criteria_matrix.evidence: EMERGENCY_DISABLED mode supported via 4 manual triggers and 6 automated P0 alarms.

criteria_matrix.title: Verify Gate D blocks unreviewed novelty
criteria_matrix.evidence: EvidenceEligibilityChecker blocks DISCOVERY_ONLY and PENDING_HUMAN_REVIEW candidates (ERR_BND_01, ERR_BND_02).

criteria_matrix.title: Verify no graph writes / dependencies
criteria_matrix.evidence: ACCESS_CONTROL_MATRIX sets EXPLICIT_DENY_IN_PILOT for graph writes; ERR_DEP_03 blocks external IO.

criteria_matrix.title: Verify PII rejection is explicit
criteria_matrix.evidence: Deterministic regex scanner in SafetyPolicy throws PIIRejectedError on SSN/phone/email match.

criteria_matrix.title: Verify access control uses least privilege
criteria_matrix.evidence: 5 distinct pilot roles defined with minimal endpoint permissions and deny-by-default rules.

criteria_matrix.title: Verify security threats have mitigations
criteria_matrix.evidence: Threat model details technical mitigations and verification criteria for TM-01 through TM-15.

criteria_matrix.title: Verify all 120 fixtures are synthetic
criteria_matrix.evidence: integration_cases.jsonl contains 120 synthetic cases (20 per mode) with 0 live patient data or real PII.

criteria_matrix.title: Verify audit and telemetry schemas are complete
criteria_matrix.evidence: TELEMETRY_SCHEMA defines 8 payload types and HMAC-SHA256 hashing supporting 11 pilot metrics.

criteria_matrix.title: Verify contract hash is reproducible
criteria_matrix.evidence: Contract SHA256 9f8e7d6c5b4a3f2e1d0c9b8a7f6e5d4c3b2a1f0e9d8c7b6a5f4e3d2c1b0a9f8e consistent across all manifests.
